mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board (user_id, category_id, title, content, like_count, view_count, created_at, updated_at, address) VALUES (#{userId}, #{categoryId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{likeCount}, #{viewCount}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{address})

INSERT INTO board_img (board_id, path, system_name, origin_name, main_whether) VALUES
(#{boardImg.boardId}, #{boardImg.path}, #{boardImg.systemName}, #{boardImg.originName}, #{boardImg.mainWhether})
mapper.select:
SELECT b.board_id, u.email, u.nickname, c.name, b.delete_whether, title, b.content, like_count, b.created_at, b.updated_at, address, board_img_id, path, system_name, origin_name, main_whether, CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, b.created_at, NOW()) < 60 THEN CONCAT(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, b.created_at, NOW()), '초 전') WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, b.created_at, NOW()) < 60 THEN CONCAT(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, b.created_at, NOW()), '분 전') WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, b.created_at, NOW()) < 24 THEN CONCAT(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, b.created_at, NOW()), '시간 전') ELSE CONCAT(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, b.created_at, NOW()), '일 전') END AS time_ago, count(r.board_id) AS reply_count FROM board b LEFT JOIN board_img bi ON b.board_id = bi.board_id AND bi.main_whether = 'M' JOIN user u ON u.user_id = b.user_id JOIN board_category c ON c.board_category_id = b.category_id LEFT JOIN reply r ON b.board_id = r.board_id WHERE b.delete_whether LIKE 'N'
AND (b.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchWord}, '%') OR b.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchWord}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchWord}, '%'))
AND (b.content LIKE CONCAT('%', '', '%') OR b.title LIKE CONCAT('%', '', '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', '', '%'))
AND c.board_category_id = #{boardCategoryId}
GROUP BY b.board_id, u.email, u.nickname, c.name, b.delete_whether, title, b.content, like_count, b.created_at, b.updated_at, address, board_img_id, path, system_name, origin_name, main_whether
ORDER BY created_at DESC
ORDER BY created_at ASC
ORDER BY like_count DESC, created_at DESC
ORDER BY view_count DESC, created_at DESC
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{listSize}

SELECT b.board_id, u.email, u.nickname, u.profile_url, c.board_category_id, c.name, b.delete_whether, title, b.content, like_count, b.created_at, b.updated_at, address, CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, b.created_at, NOW()) < 60 THEN CONCAT(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, b.created_at, NOW()), '초 전') WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, b.created_at, NOW()) < 60 THEN CONCAT(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, b.created_at, NOW()), '분 전') WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, b.created_at, NOW()) < 24 THEN CONCAT(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, b.created_at, NOW()), '시간 전') ELSE CONCAT(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, b.created_at, NOW()), '일 전') END AS time_ago, count(r.board_id) AS reply_count FROM board b JOIN user u ON u.user_id = b.user_id JOIN board_category c ON c.board_category_id = b.category_id LEFT JOIN reply r ON r.board_id = b.board_id WHERE b.board_id = #{boardId} AND delete_whether LIKE 'N' GROUP BY b.board_id, u.email, u.nickname, u.profile_url, c.board_category_id, c.name, b.delete_whether, title, content, like_count, b.created_at, b.updated_at, address;
SELECT board_img_id, path, system_name, origin_name, main_whether FROM board_img WHERE board_id = #{boardId};
mapper.update: UPDATE board SET delete_whether = 'Y' WHERE board_id = #{boardId}
mapper.select: SELECT b.board_id, u.email, u.nickname, c.name, b.delete_whether, title, b.content, like_count, b.created_at, b.updated_at, address, board_img_id, path, system_name, origin_name, main_whether, CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, b.created_at, NOW()) < 60 THEN CONCAT(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, b.created_at, NOW()), '초 전') WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, b.created_at, NOW()) < 60 THEN CONCAT(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, b.created_at, NOW()), '분 전') WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, b.created_at, NOW()) < 24 THEN CONCAT(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, b.created_at, NOW()), '시간 전') ELSE CONCAT(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, b.created_at, NOW()), '일 전') END AS time_ago, view_count FROM board b LEFT JOIN board_img bi ON b.board_id = bi.board_id AND bi.main_whether = 'M' JOIN user u ON u.user_id = b.user_id JOIN board_category c ON c.board_category_id = b.category_id LEFT JOIN reply r ON b.board_id = r.board_id WHERE b.delete_whether LIKE 'N' AND b.created_at BETWEEN DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND NOW() GROUP BY b.board_id, u.email, u.nickname, c.name, b.delete_whether, title, b.content, like_count, b.created_at, b.updated_at, address, board_img_id, path, system_name, origin_name, main_whether ORDER BY view_count DESC, created_at LIMIT 0, 5;
